questions.qtext: Based on the given paragraph, identify the meaning of the word stalking in the context of this paragraph : I once saw a lioness stalking a 3 month old kid. The ground was very open and the kid saw the lioness while she was still some distance away and started bleating whereon the lioness gave up her stalk and walked straight up to it.

options.text: moving quietly without being seen or heard

questions.solution:
(d)
Stalking here refers to a silent approach of the lioness towards the 3 month old kid. She straight away walked up to the kind once the kid started crying (bleating) giving up all caution.
